name: IntelTechniques Facebook

name: Facebook Entity ID Parser
summary: Extracts numeric Facebook IDs from profile pages and URLs.
detail: Facebook's numeric IDs (e.g., 100012345678) are stable identifiers that persist even when a user changes their vanity URL. Extracting the ID is a critical step for tracking a profile over time.
howTo: Navigate to the target's Facebook profile
Use browser DevTools → Network tab, look for UID in requests
proTip: The numeric ID never changes — bookmark it as your stable reference for a subject even if they change their vanity URL.

Set a radius

summary: Facebook search tool that works around the limited native search.

Apply filters for location, employer, or school

Review whether it appeared in the leak

name: Twint
summary: Twitter scraping tool — bypass API limits to collect tweets and profiles.
detail: Scrapes Twitter without using the API — no rate limits, no authentication required. Collect all tweets from a user, search by keyword or hashtag, or pull follower/following lists.

Scrape user tweets: twint -u username
proTip: Use --json flag to save structured data for programmatic processing.
